newsitem.title: SPAIN: CEPSA sees 20,000 bpd Algeria RKF output by yr-end.
newsitem.headline: CEPSA sees 20,000 bpd Algeria RKF output by yr-end.

text.p: Spanish oil firm Cia Espanola de Petroleos SA (CEPSA) forecasts output of 20,000 barrels per day of crude by year-end from its Rhourde el Khrouf (RKF) oilfield in Algeria, a spokesman said on Friday.
"We started production in June at a rate of 5,000 bpd and by the end of the year we expect this to rise to 20,000. Reserves in the RKF field total around 150 million barrels," he said.
He said the firm was "optimistic" about a second Orhroud (ORD) oilfield in Algeria and expects production to be greater than the KRF field, but as yet the firm has not completed production tests.
Cepsa is currently negotiating with Algerian state oil firm Sonatrach and Anadarko Petroleum Corp on how the ORD field will be divided up, the spokesman said.
